title: Playing duets with her father and the home recording
summary: She no longer plays; she and her father played cornet and piano solos and made a home disc of Oh Lovely Night, now lost.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I doubt if I could play any piano anymore.
Oh, you haven't played recently? No.

I haven't played in years. Oh, that's pretty good. But my daddy and I used to play together. I had, um, a book of, uh, carnet and piano solos. He would play, you know, the leads and I would accompany him. And we made one little record of, uh, Oh Lovely Night. Oh, you did? Uh huh. And, uh, is that...
The record is gone. That's too bad.

You know how you used to buy the little discs and you'd put it right at home and we made it together? Wow. And Tales from Huffman. We made that. We used to play all the time. Good music. And Balsays from Jocelyn. Oh yeah. Used to play that. All those good numbers.
